blocks.text: The familiar chaos of meeting the in-laws returns in “Focker-in-Law,” the latest installment in the “Meet the Parents” franchise, offering a mix of awkward encounters, misunderstandings and heartwarming family moments. Directed by John Hamburg, the 2026 comedy brings back Ben Stiller as Greg Focker, who now finds himself on the other side of the dreaded family introduction. This time, Greg has to meet his son Henry’s (Skyler Gisondo) girlfriend, Olivia Jones (Ariana Grande), who is preparing to become part of the Focker family.
